g.text: OffPageForm: what the page doesn't draw
Accent, Kicker, the recording, the website
the guide, as the bar at
the CV drawn, a band per
ResumeChanged: listened for, it is edited in place
IResumeSource: the API, or the host's file

text.tspan: The site holds only its words, demos and CV:
the pages sit on the framework's shell, every place on them has its own address through the places package. Its CV is one record, drawn by one view that the admin edits where it stands.
